name: GlianaAI
tagline: Say what you want made: GlianaAI picks the right one of 170+ image, video, voice and music models and tools, quotes the price, then runs it.
description:
GlianaAI is one pay-per-call API for 170+ AI models and tools. This app puts it inside Anna with an AI planner in front.

1. Describe what you want: "a 5-second video of a lighthouse at dusk", "an Indonesian voice-over of this paragraph", "30 seconds of lo-fi music", "a screenshot of this page", "today's weather warnings for Jakarta". Attach an image to edit or animate it.
2. Anna's AI picks the best-value model or tool from the live GlianaAI catalogue and writes its settings.
3. You see the plan and the exact price before anything runs.
4. Run it: the result (image, video, audio or data) appears in the window, with what it cost and your balance.

Runs are paid from your own GlianaAI balance with your API key (BYOK): top up in rupiah with QRIS or in USDC at dashboard.glianalabs.com, no subscription. Planning uses your Anna credits. A failed call is not charged. Generated files are kept for 7 days.
